verses: Kiya tujhay bhi chupa lenay wali (qayamat) ki khabar phonchi hai
Uss din boht say chehray zaleel hun gay
(aur) mehnat kerney walay thakay huye hun gay
Woh dehakti hui aag mein jayen gay
Aur nihayat garum chashmay ka pani unn ko pilaya jaye ga
Unn kay liye siwaye siway-e-kanty daar darakhton kay aur kuch khaney ko na hoga
Jo na mota keray ga na bhook mitaey ga
Boht say chehray uss din tar-o-taza aur (aasoodah haal) hun gay
Apni koshish per khush hun gay
Buland bala jannaton mein hun gay
Jahan koi byhoda baat nahi sunen gay
Jahan bhyta hua chashma hoga
(aur) uss mein unchay unchay takht hun gay
Aur aabkhoray rakhay huye (hun gay)
Aur aik qatar mein lagay huye takiey hun gay
Aur makhmali masnadein pheli pari hun gi
Kiya yeh oonton ko nahi dekhtay kay woh kiss tarah peda kiye gaye hain
Aur aasman ko kay kiss tarah ooncha kiya gaya hai
Aur paharon ki taraf kay kiss tarah gaar diye gaye hain
Aur zamin ki taraf kay kiss tarah bechaei gaee hai
Pus aap naseehat ker diya keren (kyunkay) aap sirf naseehat kerney walay hain
Aap kuch unn per daroghah nahi hain
Haan! jo shakhs roo-gardani keray aur kufur keray
Ussay Allah Taalaa boht bara azab dey ga
Be-shak humari taraf unn ka lotna hai
Phir be-shak humaray zimmay hai unn say hisab lena
